node_id.description: Only expose the mixer of a device on a specific node with the given ID (corresponds to --node=ID)

port.description: Specify use of IEEE1394 port NUM (corresponds to --port=NUM)

verbose.description: Produce verbose output with the given LEVEL; higher values produce more output (corresponds to --verbose=LEVEL)

quiet.description: If true, suppress all output (corresponds to --quiet)
